- **CRITICAL** · Pack mounts / cage / tie-downs, HV cable clamps, grommets at every pass-through (Adam; shop log Drivetrain tasks · BACKLOG Mechanical)
- **CRITICAL** · Charge-plug interlock. No drive while plugged in, and no charging below 0 °C or with stale/unverified temps (TEMPS_VERIFIED=0 today). (Gilfoyle; BACKLOG.md:51)
- **CRITICAL** · Contactor weld check. Bus voltage vs pack with mains commanded open at key-off and before precharge (sim has a welded-contactor toggle; firmware not built). (Gilfoyle; BACKLOG.md:52)
- **CRITICAL** · Isolation monitoring (HV to chassis). Part not chosen. (Sparky; BACKLOG.md:53)

- **CRITICAL** · MSD rating ≈350 A (schematic/gen.py) is below the 550 A launch current. Verify against Volt specs or replace with a combined bus fuse. (Sparky; BACKLOG.md:56)
- **CRITICAL** · Firmware dead-LEM detection. Read each LEM separately and flag one reading nothing or out of range (>450 A, PROPOSED) as a hard fault that engages the 10 mph cap. Today this check runs only in the sim. (chief, 2026-10-21) (Gilfoyle; BACKLOG.md:75)
- **CRITICAL** · Two-track pedal. Today ONE pedal wiper is read by both Teensys (A pin 40, B pin 41, same signal through two dividers; docs/THROTTLE_CLAMP.md), so a pedal fault looks identical on both. Fit a dual-output Hall pedal (two independent tracks, e.g. one track ×½): Teensy A reads track 1 and Teensy B reads track 2, each on its own pin (PROPOSED: keep A pin 40 / B pin 41, no shared wiper), with a plausibility check between the tracks (PROPOSED: > 10 % for 100 ms → throttle 0 + fault). Part not chosen. (Gilfoyle; BACKLOG.md:79)
- **CRITICAL** · Brake overrides throttle: brake and throttle both pressed > 0.5 s → throttle cut to 0 until the pedal returns to 0 (PROPOSED). Partly covered: sim brake switch cuts throttle (sim/vehicle.js); Kelly "Brake H-Pedal" option (docs/KELLY_CAN_ROLES.md) is a config check. Firmware Teensy rule not built. (Gilfoyle; BACKLOG.md:80)
- **CRITICAL** · Kelly CAN timeout (> 200 ms, PROPOSED) → derate + fault (KELLY-CAN-LOST). Today stale Kelly CAN only makes Park false (include/ParkState.h); BMS_CAP_KELLY_RX=0. (Gilfoyle; BACKLOG.md:83)
- **CRITICAL** · Kelly/motor cooling control from Kelly controller + motor temps (Kelly CAN): pump on with key (COOL_PUMP pin 8), radiator fan relay at ~40 °C (RAD_FAN pin 7), PROPOSED pins reserved in Config.h, not built; Kelly derates itself at 90 °C case (SOURCED manual). (Gilfoyle; BACKLOG.md:85)
